introduction.p: Consider the eight bit strings of length 3. Lets find the number of strings that start with 1 or have weight 2 (i.e., contain exactly two 1s).

statement.p: List all the 3-bit strings that start with 1.
List all the 3-bit strings that have weight 2.
Now list all the 3-bit strings that start with 1 or have weight 2. But be lazy: Dont list them from scratch. Use your lists from the two tasks above.
